steps.content: Your eyes gradually adjust to the light, as blurry patches of color slowly come into focus.
The apocalyptic scene around you dissolves like a fading mirage, while the sounds of explosions, screams, and crackling flames retreat like an ebbing tide.
In the silent interrogation room, surrounded by iron-grey walls, a single iron lamp casts its triangular beam across the table, illuminating both you and your subject, each drenched in sweat.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I must say, it's quite something to feel this exhausted from your "story" even when no one was actually coveting my Qi.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: It is a "story" after all—the most profound experience comes from complete immersion.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: How else could it feel so authentic?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So authentic that it turned into a "life or death situation."

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Yugu leans back in her chair, tilts her head back, and lets out a soft laugh.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: I shall take that as a compliment.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I stepped into your "story" the moment I entered this interrogation room, didn't I?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It all started with that unfinished tale of yours, where you painted MBCC as a ferocious tiger.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: You knew from the beginning?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...Of course.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You're such a great storyteller. When I came in, I couldn't help but wonder what story you'd come up with this time.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: For that, I'm willing to see where your narrative leads.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Yugu seems pleased with your response as if having received applause. Her eyebrow arches elegantly as a subtle smile plays across her lips.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: So trusting of me this time, are you?

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Yet you absolutely refused to play your part in my script during the fete.

steps.speaker: Option
options: I'm not following it this time either.

choices.text: I'm not following it this time either.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: And that's precisely why we "meet" here again.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: You pinch the bridge of your nose before reaching for the documents on the table, leafing through several pages.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: As it turned out, finding information about Yugu wasn't difficult. You had your contacts at the Eastian delegation conduct a thorough investigation.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: A wandering taleteller known for her tales of tragedy and calamity, she is as famous as the spiritual myths that drift through the alleys of Eastia.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Though the information is fragmentary, you've managed to piece together enough for a dossier that would satisfy an interrogation.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The Wisp... is you, right?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Or should I say... the past you?

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The records match what you have learned: she came from the happiest of families, sheltered like a hothouse flower from all suffering. Yet when calamity struck and her family tried to flee, she chose to face it head-on—a decision that led to the destruction of everything she held dear.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: No one understood why she made that choice. Even her parents were deeply bewildered, though they eventually let her go.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Can I ask what drove you to this path?

choices.text: Can I ask what drove you to this path?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What really made you...

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: To be honest with you... this is the first time I have included myself into one of my tales.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Yugu cuts off your question and takes the liberty to speak on her own.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: I've chased after calamities and Corruptors, listening to countless tales that would bring anyone to tears of grief and anguish.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: I wove them into stories and spread them far and wide. People fail to comprehend—they see me as an ill omen, unable to fathom why I have chosen such a path.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Hehe... Why seek so many reasons, though?

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: It's simply because... what makes my soul shatter and my body tremble isn't happiness, nor is it the so-called love... but rather the tragedy that erupts when both are destroyed...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Yugu's shoulders quiver slightly as if savoring the tragic ending of the story woven from her memories.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: In these chaotic times, I once lived a false life—treating happiness as commonplace and mistaking my sheltered paradise for the whole world, all thanks to my family's wealth and influence.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Yet in this vast world beyond, wounds, flesh, and tears—these are the essence of reality! They are what genuinely stir one's soul, making my very marrow burn with excitement!

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: My heart aches and pulsates with exquisite agony... Ah... This! This is what elevates a tale to true sublimity, deserving to be preserved and recounted for generations to come!

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: The supposed happy endings and joyful plays are mere fleeting illusions of peace, fading with time. It is when the most exquisite things are shattered and obliterated, with the agony lived through and engraved in memory... It is only then that people will recall the taste of blood on their tongues, like a sweet kiss of a blade.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Yugu is lost in ecstasy, and the Mania in the interrogation room seems to resonate with her emotions, threatening to manifest another "story."

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Crimson thorns flash through the air as you suppress Yugu's growing agitation.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Though visibly displeased, the subject in the interrogation chair straightens her posture and continues to comply with your investigation.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: However... my narratives are but reflections of what I have observed, tales woven from the experiences of others.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: It can never truly capture that deep, personal agony...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So that's why you wrote yourself into a story—to experience your own tragedy?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But you also wrote me into it. You should've known since the fete that I would never stand idly by in the face of suffering.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Indeed... Akin to all, you too harbor a fondness for happy endings.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Despite recognizing the individual before you is distinct—a soul drawn to tragedy, embraces chaos, and craves the world's demise—you would extend a hand to rescue me.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Just like a saint.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Her sudden frankness leaves you at a loss for words. Watching your expression, Yugu purses her lips, barely containing her obvious delight.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...When I save someone, I don't judge them based on who they are.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Your stories are too dangerous. As your appointed "supervisor" in custody, it's my duty to prevent things from escalating further.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Yugu raises her hand slightly and draws her veil halfway down—no surge of Mania emanates from the surroundings, signaling to you what this gesture stands for.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: No storytelling tricks, no imagined scenarios—what follows will be her true words, her genuine thoughts, expressed in their most direct form.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: That is why I chose to weave you into my tales.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: You have experienced and witnessed countless tragedies. Though you know the path ahead is fraught with hardship, you still strive to grasp what little hope remains in this world, yearning for its survival.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: I wonder, how far would you go to fulfill that desire?

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: If one day you were to lose your life in this pursuit, what tragic fate would befall this world?

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Around you, a plethora of stories could unfold... And almost every one of them leads to the tragic endings I so adore.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Yugu gazes at you as if you were her favorite character come to life—torn between preserving your essence and yielding to her urge to mold you into someone who would perfectly satisfy her desires.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Throughout my extensive journeys, I have encountered numerous individuals like you—honorable souls embodying true humanity.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Yet... when it comes to someone who could genuinely embrace me and forge such a deep bond with me...

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: You emerge as the only one.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The last words are spoken with tender intimacy, yet they send a cold shiver down your spine.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: You recall her earlier story, and realize that more than the MBCC she painted, she herself is like a tiger lurking in the shadows, bearing its fangs, viewing you as dying prey awaiting consumption.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Yet you willingly choose to be this tiger's feast.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: You fidget with your pen cap, clicking it open and shut. The sound echoes through the interrogation room.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Like many others, I really dislike feeling tired, I struggle with tough times, and I absolutely love vacations.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's just that I accepted these powers bestowed upon me by someone unknown.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: These powers came at a price. Countless lives paved this path with their flesh and blood. And I... have already started walking down it.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: On this path lie fates far worse than my own death, but I will do everything in my power to prevent them.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: You pick up a notebook from the table—it's Yugu's record of stories. The previously nameless cover now bears the title Once Upon A Spring Eve, written in elegant Eastian script after the fete.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: You turn to the last written page, which details the events of that night at the fete.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Humans are greedy, arrogant, and pleasure-seeking. As you said, once they grow accustomed to happiness, they descend into maddened despair when disaster strikes.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But you still underestimate "humanity"... You underestimate their pursuit of happiness.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Some are stubborn enough to attempt reversing time itself, while others willingly give their lives for this cause.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Even in the face of catastrophe, you'll see lovers in a tight embrace and children nestled in their parents' arms. Even among strangers, if you seek comfort, someone will hold you close as you face the end together.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: You uncap your pen and, clumsily mimicking Yugu's handwriting from the previous pages, add a few words in Eastian script after the story of the fete: "To be continued."

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So you see, your sought-after "spectacle of humanity's madness as their world crumbles" is actually people's final expression of the very happiness you despise.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: No matter what, this world will not end in despair—and even if it does, I still hope that everyone experiences at least one moment of happiness before the end.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Yugu falls silent, her unwavering gaze fixed upon you as if trying to peer into your very soul.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: After a long silence, you hear her break into stifled laughter.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: I'm thrilled... that you still hold true to these beliefs.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Thank you for writing "To be continued" for me, but... I think it's time I start a new volume.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Yugu rises slightly and reaches for a new notebook lying on the table, taking it into her hands.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Heh... I know full well that if destruction were to befall this world, you would pour every ounce of your strength into saving it.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: You possess a natural inclination to rescue others. With you in existence, this world will forever hold the promise of revival.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Yugu gazes at you as emotion-laden words flow from her lips, stirring the Mania and weaving your powers together.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: The perfect shall shatter, and happiness shall fade.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Yet you and those like you never cease gathering fragments of hope.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Your existence will lead all my tales down different paths...

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: And perhaps... because of you, I too shall find my place within these narratives.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Yugu gently channels her power, letting it caress your hands and back like a gossamer touch as if giving you an ethereal embrace across the void.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Your future is inscribed with countless tribulations, nearly equivalent to living through the end of the world...

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: But until that time comes, please allow me to remain by your side.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: I accept your restraints on me and await your command. For your prosperous reign, I shall fulfill any request you make of me.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Even if it means bringing your vision of a beautiful world to life.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Yet I shall persist in waiting, observing for the final chapter to unfold... For I am, above all, a teller of tales, and I do love... a perfect tragedy.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What matters to me is never the ending, but rather every moment along the way.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Living each moment with a clear conscience, one after another... I believe that will lead me to a worthy ending.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: And even if I don't succeed, that's fine too.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If the doom is destined, I'll make sure I'm the last one standing. Whatever comes after that... well, who cares?

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Heh... Fate is the greatest playwright of all. Who knows what dramatic twists await you?

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Just thinking of all the possible plot threads makes my veins tingle with thrill.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: In that case, stay close to me.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Only in this way can you witness everything firsthand and experience a story that involves you as well. Isn't that what you want?
Yugu dons her veil once more and offers you a graceful bow, every bit the picture of a demure Eastian lady. Yet you can see the madness lurking in her eyes—and you've chosen to embrace it fully.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Naturally... Chief.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: From this day forward, I shall remain by your side, unwavering until death.
